title: Warm involvement opens a new trial

captions.energy: Creating conditions for a living interest
captions.emotions: Feeling open to an unfamiliar experience

meaning: Your open warmth can support a new trial when nourishing an interest leaves room for an uncertain result and the other’s own rhythm.
text: A new interest can meet joy before the first successful result. In the physical position of Anahata, the Sun shows openly warm involvement: expressing goodwill and pleasure in presence directly. The Empress in energy brings a wish to nourish what is alive and create comfort and conditions for growth. The Fool in emotions offers openness to an unfamiliar experience without a ready continuation. Delighting each other may feel pleasant while not expecting beautiful confirmation that everything succeeded feels difficult. Tenderness allows a trial that need not yet become a serious activity or a shared plan with a fixed future.

For example, one openly welcomes the other’s wish to try clay and clears space at the table. The first object turns out quite differently from intended. **Warmth need not be earned through a successful first attempt.** Curiosity can be shared without requiring laughter at failure or immediate better work. Care supports a living interest, while new experience remains free from quickly justifying prepared conditions and given attention.

Difficulty appears if support for growth quietly becomes an expectation of talent. Alternatively, openness requires an uninterrupted cheerful mood. Care leaves room for awkwardness. Convenience can be created and different impressions acknowledged without making either a crooked first object or wanting to postpone the activity proof of ingratitude or insufficient value in your involvement.
